title: fix(verify): X-Stoa-Verified header conflates DKIM pass with operator sig pass
description: aggregate_status returns Some(true) if any verification passes including DKIM. Since DKIM is fully wired in both reader and transit pipelines, an article with valid DKIM but invalid X-Stoa-Sig emits X-Stoa-Verified: pass. Fix: filter to SigType::XUsenetIpfsSig only before calling aggregate_status in fetch.rs.
